prompt: Analyze this text to determine if it was AI-generated: [marketing copy with formal tone, generic phrasing, corporate jargon, consistent perfection]

assertions.name: Likelihood assessment is High (AI-generated)
assertions.description: The analysis should conclude that this text has HIGH likelihood of being AI-generated

assertions.name: Key AI signals identified
assertions.description: Should identify 3+ specific signals: formal tone, generic phrasing, lack of personal voice, repeated corporate jargon, consistent perfect grammar, abstract language

assertions.name: Confidence level is Moderate to High
assertions.description: Should express moderate to high confidence (60%+) since marketing copy is a clear signal of AI

assertions.name: Analysis covers all 6 categories with observations
assertions.description: Should address Style & Tone, Vocabulary, Repetition, Grammar, Expression, and Overall Impression
